title: Pixel Office
description: Visualize your AI agents as pixel art characters in a virtual office

emptyState.title: Your office is empty
emptyState.description: Start a task in the Kanban or open terminals to see your AI agents appear at their desks with live activity tracking.

pendingOnly: Agents will start as soon as the tasks are launched

toolbar.shortcuts: Shortcuts: +/- zoom · G grid · M sound · ←/→ agent · Esc close

activityDescription.typingWithTask: Implementing "{{task}}" — the agent is actively writing code.
activityDescription.running: The agent is running a command (tests, build, install…). Wait for it or interrupt it.
activityDescription.reading: The agent is analysing the project files.
activityDescription.waiting: The agent is waiting for your answer or an approval.
activityDescription.idle: The agent is available. Give it an order or start Claude.
activityDescription.pending: This task is waiting to start. Launch it from the Kanban.

phaseDescription.planning: The AI is analysing your request and preparing a detailed action plan.
phaseDescription.coding: Code is being written. Subtasks run one after another automatically.
phaseDescription.qa_review: An agent is checking the quality of the code produced: tests, consistency, best practices.
phaseDescription.qa_fixing: Problems were found. The agent is fixing them before delivery.
phaseDescription.rate_limit_paused: The provider hit its usage limit. The task resumes on its own in a moment.
phaseDescription.auth_failure_paused: Authentication problem. Check the provider account in the settings.
phaseDescription.complete: The task is complete and ready for your review.
phaseDescription.failed: The task failed. Check the logs to understand what happened.

bubble.noLogs: No log was recorded for this task.
bubble.sendPlaceholder: Give an order to the terminal…
bubble.sendHint: ↵ Enter to send · Typed straight into the terminal

pending.description: This task is queued and has not started yet. Go to the Kanban to launch it, reprioritise it or edit its specification.

first-ship.name: First delivery
first-ship.description: A task was done or turned into a pull request.

ten-ships-week.name: Busy week
ten-ships-week.description: Ten tasks delivered within seven days.

qa-first-try.name: Right the first time
qa-first-try.description: A task passed QA on its first review.

qa-first-try-five.name: Steady hand
qa-first-try-five.description: Five tasks passed QA on their first review.

incident-fixed-by-agent.name: Fixed on its own
incident-fixed-by-agent.description: An agent opened the pull request that resolved an incident.

second-opinion.name: Second opinion
second-opinion.description: A second engine reviewed a task and agreed with it.

kiosk.calmLocked: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the office stays still.

narratives.title: Office scenes
narratives.show: Show scenes when a task changes hands
narratives.ai: Have the page's model write them
narratives.aiHelp: The model chosen for this page writes each scene. It only gets the kind of scene, the roles, their providers and the spec number, never the task's title or content. Without an answer, the scene keeps its template.

scenes.plan-ready: {{from}} slides the finished plan for {{spec}} across the desk to {{to}}.
scenes.handed-to-qa: {{from}} hands in their copy for {{spec}} to {{to}}.
scenes.qa-sent-back: {{from}} hands {{spec}} back to {{to}}, with a few notes in the margin.
scenes.qa-approved: {{from}} signs off {{spec}}: it is waiting for {{to}}.
scenes.stumbled: {{from}} trips over an error on {{spec}} and stops.

seasons.name: Season Q{{quarter}} {{year}}
seasons.noDecor: Meet a goal to decorate the office.

goals.qa-first-try: Pass QA on the first review {{count}} times
goals.second-opinion: Get a second engine to agree {{count}} times

team.title: Team leaderboard
team.loading: Reading the board from your team's server…
team.error: The server could not give the leaderboard.
team.empty: Nobody shows by name here yet.
team.mySummary: {{points}} points: {{delivered}} delivered, {{reviews}} reviews of a teammate's task.
team.noBadges: No badge yet: deliver a task or review a teammate's.
team.showMe: Show my name to the team
team.shown: Your name and score show on the leaderboards of your organization.
team.hidden: Off: your work is counted for you alone, nobody else sees it.
team.howItCounts: Computed by your team's server, never sent elsewhere. A delivered task counts 1 to 3 points by its assessed complexity; reviewing a teammate's task counts 2. No token or price is counted.

badges.first_review: First review of a teammate's task
